The Subtask Name: Determine the directors of the films and their birth dates

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Performed internet searches to gather information about the directors and their birth dates
  -- Observation: Found that Jason Michael Brescia directed "The Newest Pledge" and Oscar Barney Finn directed "Días Allá De La Aventura"
  -- Thought: Needed to compare the directors' birth dates to determine which was born earlier
  -- Result: Identified Jason Michael Brescia (born 1986-06-19) and Oscar Barney Finn (born 1938-10-28)
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Coordinated the tasks and analyzed results
  -- Observation: Gathered information about both directors
  -- Thought: Compared the birth dates to find the director born earlier
  -- Result: Determined Oscar Barney Finn was born earlier
